records.possible_job: Product, positioning or route-to-market decision about a defined payroll buyer and operating problem.
records.possible_output_value: A scoped case comparison and briefing may clarify needs, objections and evidence used in decisions.
records.intended_use_and_rights_to_establish: Internal product/commercial decision support; separate permission if using material in marketing.
records.limits: Cannot infer adoption rate, software market share, product preference, conversion or an addressable lead list.

records.possible_job: Define service boundaries, retained employer work, transition support or evidence for a specific proposition.
records.possible_output_value: Case context may help distinguish the work a buyer needs from a generic outsourcing label.
records.intended_use_and_rights_to_establish: Internal service design/use; external sales collateral is a separate use.
records.limits: No supplier endorsement, outsourced-service ranking, probability of switching or buyer contacts.

records.possible_job: Choose a payroll integration, delivery or adjacent proposition and its actual buyer context.
records.possible_output_value: A clearly scoped payroll decision lens may complement wider HCM material.
records.intended_use_and_rights_to_establish: Internal strategy/product use; separately defined excerpts or client-use rights if wanted.
records.limits: No generalisation from payroll-only cases to all HR technology or every geography.

records.possible_job: Prepare a client decision brief or improve a repeatable advisory method for a defined payroll problem.
records.possible_output_value: An evidence-based synthesis or framework might reduce duplicated discovery or expose missing evidence. That usefulness is untested.
records.intended_use_and_rights_to_establish: Named client-facing deliverable/quotation/redistribution must be distinguished from internal reading.
records.limits: Not an automatic sublicence, client-data submission, commissioned due diligence or bespoke consulting service.

records.possible_job: Orient sector research or test an investment thesis about payroll operating needs and buying constraints.
records.possible_output_value: Scoped qualitative context can identify questions for later diligence.
records.intended_use_and_rights_to_establish: Internal research use; external portfolio/client circulation separately specified where relevant.
records.limits: Not investment advice, deal due diligence, valuation, total market estimate, purchase forecast or company scoring.

records.possible_job: Support an actual payroll investment, change, renewal or operating decision.
records.possible_output_value: An application briefing or genuinely additional use may be useful beyond the free research received by a practitioner contributor.
records.intended_use_and_rights_to_establish: First establish already granted free access and actual incremental service/use; do not manufacture restrictions.
records.limits: Not a contract-prioritised primary buyer or a presumed second paid report copy.
